page.overview:
Who is Predator King?

The "Predator King" was an old and the leader of a clan that wielded an arsenal made of vibranium, an Earth metal the Yautja called "godmetal". He had two sons, Graveyard and the Predator Prince, and he favored his older son to the point where the Prince sought revenge against his family after a hunt between the King's sons left him defeated and humiliated. The Predator King achieved his title due to him being the greatest killer of the clan, and he sought to invade Earth, kill all of its protectors, and reduce the planet to a hunting preserve. With valuable intel on the heroes and villains of Earth provided by Kraven the Hunter, a human who had earned the Yautja's respect by killing their most dishonorable member, he was able to put this plan into action.

Despite being the greatest hunter in the clan and orchestrating the invasion of Earth, the Predator King was an arrogant leader that preferred to sit on the sidelines, remaining aboard his mothership on the dark side of the moon while his soldiers, his son, and his human ally provided the bulk of the invasion force. He also decided not to study Kraven's kill list of Earth's heroes and believed them to be easy prey that would give him no challenge. This arrogance and overconfidence ultimately proved to be his undoing: upon spotting the Invisible Woman of the Fantastic Four (aka Susan Storm) infiltrating his ship and attempting to overload its fusion core, the Predator King boasted of his victory to his fellow Predators before attempting to kill her, unaware of her abilities and uncaring towards her identity. Because of this, he did not expect Sue to summon a forcefield from inside his body that would rip him apart from the inside out, killing the Predator King. Sue would then sacrifice herself to disrupt the mothership's core and destroy it, wiping out all the Predators on board and ending their invasion.
